title: Items Sold
summary: Units and revenue per item for the dates you pick, counted by when each item was paid for.

blocks.text: Items Sold shows how many of each item sold, and for how much, over the dates you pick: Today, Last 7 days, Month, 3 months or your own range.

items: An item counts on the day it was **paid for**, not the day {pos} files the order under. Pay tonight for tomorrow's pickup and it counts tonight.
Revenue is each item's own price after item discounts, before tax.
Add-ons like an extra topping are already inside their item's price in {pos}, so they aren't counted again.
An order that isn't paid yet doesn't count on any day until it is.

blocks.text: Totals can differ a little from {pos}'s own dashboard, on purpose. {pos} groups by its business day and uses each check's total (after check-level discounts). Both are right; they answer different questions.

Today is read live from {pos} when you open the page (a read under a minute old is reused; Refresh reads again). Past days are copied from {pos} each night. A few times a day the last 14 days are compared with {pos}'s own totals and any day that changed (a void the next morning, a late payment) is copied again.
**Download CSV** saves the whole range. **Download sales data** under the table gives every line item sold, with price, tax and void status, as CSV or PDF.
People with Hide sales numbers don't get this page.
